tei:div.tei:p: "!# yang zab rtsa gsum snying po'i skor las: bla ma drag po padma gtum po'i sgrub thabs dregs pa tshar gcod bzhugs so:

ྈ thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal lo:1$0000250 dregs pa thams cad tshar gcod phyir: gu ru drag po che ba'i mchog: padma gtum po bsgrub 'dod na: dur khrod gnas su mchod gtor bsham: skyabs sems tshogs gsag sngon 'gro bas: bskyed cing bzlas pa 'di ltar bya: 1$0000300hūm̐: stong gsal ngang las snod bcud kun: rab 'jigs drag po'i zhing khams dbus: padma nyi ma bdud bzhi'i steng: rang rig chu las nya 'phar ltar: skad cig dran rdzogs thod phreng rtsal: gsang bdag padma gtum po'i sku: mthing dmar lcags bsregs lta bu'i mdog: rab khros gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan: phyag g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu yis: sde brgyad 'byung po'i srog nas 'dren: g.yon pas sdigs mdzub phur bu 'dril: ma rungs logs 'dren srog rtsa gcod: rtse las sprul pa'i lcags sdig 'phro: dam sri 'gong po hab hab za: spyi gtsug rta gdong rngam bzhad 'tsher: srid gsum g.yo zhing dbang du sdud: sku smad gnam lcags phur pa'i dbal: bar chad bdud bzhi'i snying la gzir: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu brjid: mkha' 'gro chos skyong las la gzud: gshog rtser khyung chen khra thabs lding: sa bdag klu srin thal bar rlog: ba spu'i khung bu thams cad kun: rab 'byams khro bo'i phyag rgyas gtams: gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan: thugs ka'i hūm̐ 'od lcags kyu yis: ye shes 'khor bcas spyan drangs 1$0000250bsam: 1$0000300hūm̐: lho nub raksha'i pho brang nas: ma hā gu ru thod phreng rtsal: padma gtum po'i skur bzhengs la: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ dam ye dbyer med brtan par bzhugs: sgo gsum gus pa'i dad phyag 'tshal: phyi nang gsang mchod sman gtor raka: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por bzhes: sarba pū dza sa ma ya ho: pañtsa a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun 'dus thod phreng rtsal: dregs pa 'dul phyir khro bo'i tshul:

padma gtum po he ru kar: gus pas bstod do dngos grub stsol: thugs kar rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐: sngags mtshan 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis: rtsa gsum mchod cing byin nus bsdus: 'gro drug sgrib sbyangs lha ru bsgyur: dregs pa sde brgyad zil gyis mnan: dam la mi gnas gdug pa kun: ye shes me yis gzhob bzhin bsregs: rjes shul lhag ma med par 1$0000250bsam: bsnyen sgrub sngags 'di 'bum tsho bzhi: bzlas pas las kun 'grub par 'gyur: 1$0000300oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm hā gu ru padma tsaṇḍa badzra kī li kī la ya khroṃ ga ru ḍa ru ru bha sha sarba duṣṭān hūm̐ phaṭa:1$0000250 thun mthar mchod bstod dngos grub blang: dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis brjod: rdzogs rim ka dag ngang du bzhag: 1$0000300sa ma ya rgya:1$0000250 thun mtshams sha khrag gtor ma bsham: dgra bgegs dgug bsgral zhal du bstab: 1$0000300e sarba shā trūn bighnan nṛ tri dza mā ra ya rbad: ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen padma gtum po che: dbyings nas brtser dgongs 'dir gshegs byin gyis rlobs: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i sha khrag gtor ma dang: sman raka phud kyi 'dod yon mchod par bzhes: rdo rje'i go chas 'gal rkyen bar chad srungs: mi mthun zhi zhing mthun rkyen legs tshogs spel: khams gsum dbang sdus log lta cham la phob: rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub la 'tshe ba yi: gdug pa'i dgra bgegs srog rtsa dmar po chod: sde brgyad cho 'phrul 'byung bzhi'i g.yo 'khrugs dang: nad mtshon mu ge byad phur rbod gtong zlog: mngon spyod stobs kyi phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs ma ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:1$0000250 thal brdab gtor ma dgra phyogs 'phang: bar chad thams cad bzlog par 'gyur: 1$0000300sa ma ya rgya: de nas rdzas kyi sbyor ba ni:

a ru bong nga gla ba'i rtsi: ru rta shu dag gi 'u waṃ: gu gul dkar nag rdo rje gnyis: gza' bdud dang klu bdud rdo rje/ gri sha snying gsum gri snying spre'u dang ri bong snying*/ khrag sna gsum: padma rakta gri khrag dang glang dmar khrag stag sha ming can spru ba nag: yung ba chu rtsa bya rgod spos: spang spos yungs kar kyi kye ba: mkhan dmar spyang tsher dri can dgu: dri chen rta bon spyang brun mu zi gnyis ba bla ldong ros shing kun sgog skya/ glang dmar rwa gzhob dang bcas pa: skam rnams zhib btags khrag sna dang: chu sna gsum gyis sngags pa nus ldan dang byis pa lo brgyad dri chu/ ra thug gi chu/ ril bu 'am: yang na gsher du sbyar yang rung: mi bsad g.yag rgod rwa nang blugs: rang nyid gtum po'i nga rgyal brtan: oṃ padma tsaṇḍa badzra kī li kī la ya nā ga du tstshande tstshande mi li mi li bhandha bhandha nā ga na ni swā hā: rtsa ba'i rig pa khri dang ni: ner seng dzwa raṃ rbad: kha ṭa ru ṭa rbad: nā ga du na rbad: tsa ra tsa tri rbad: rā tsa thig nan rbad: ma tri ma zhung rbad: ma tra thum ril rbad: kha bsgyur stong phrag gcig gis 'grub: byugs bdug lus la 'chang bas kyang: nad gdon gnod pa thams cad thub: rdo rje'i rdzong du tshud dang 'dra: mang du ma spel dam tshig rgya: sa ma ya rgya: khyad par mchog gi srung ba ni: tho rangs lus gnad legs par bca': rlung dug dbyung la bskyed rim gsal: rang nyid padma gtum po yi: thugs las 'od zer grangs med 'phros: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs dang: gsang rig gzungs sngags nus pa dang: 'byung ba'i bcud kyi dwangs ma kun: 'ub kyis bsdus te hūm̐ la thim: de las khro bo'i nus ldan pa'i: gnam lcags zhun chu chil chil babs: lus gang nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyang: khrag 'thung nyid dang dbyer med bsam: rtsa sngags dang ni rdzas kyi sngags: kha bsgyur dang bcas ci rigs dang:

rnam par 'joms pa'i gzungs kyang bzla: thun mthar rdo rje'i sbu gu nas: me 'od dang bcas babs par bsam: dri chu bar pa khyor bar bzung: phud kyis bdud rtsi bzhin du mchod: bar pa rang gis 'thor 'thung bya: dbang po'i sgo rnams thig les gdab: 'di yis mi thub gang yang med: khyad par nyin zhag gcig gi bar: stong gsum 'khrugs kyang ya mi nga: lhag ma dam tshig ldan nges par: byin kyang rung ste shin tu gsang: sa ma ya rgya: snod rung dbang bskur cho ga ni: dkyil 'khor rdzas bsham nus ldan bsgrub: slob ma'i dri dang bgegs sbyangs la: srung 'khor gsal btab maṇḍal phul: de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni: dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang: padma gtum po bdag la dgongs: khro rgyal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: byin rlabs dbang mchog bstsal du gsol: tshogs gsag ye shes dbab cing brtan: sku dang bum pa spyi bor bzhag: hūm̐: khrag 'thung padma gtum po yi: sku ni snang la rang bzhin bral: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bskyed pa lha yi dbang thob shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sngags kyi yi ge mgrin par bzhag: hūm̐: khrag 'thung padma gtum po yi: gsung ni ma 'gag rang byung dbyangs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bzlas pa sngags kyi dbang thob shog: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: phyag mtshan rdo rje snying gar bzhag: hūm̐: khrag 'thung padma gtum po yi: thugs ni stong nyid rdo rje'i dbyings: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ting 'dzin dgongs pa'i dbang thob shog: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dpal gyi gtor ma lte bar bzhag: hūm̐: khrag 'thung padma gtum po yi: yon tan re skong yid bzhin gter: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: gang 'dul 'gro ba sgrol bar shog: gu ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: lcags kyu phur pa g.yas g.yon gtad: hūm̐: khrag 'thung padma gtum po yi: phrin las dgra bgegs dgug cing sgrol: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mngon spyod stobs kyi dbang thob shog:

karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: spro na dgra bgegs dgug bsgral bstab: bskul zhing gtor ma dgra phyogs 'phang: bkra shis rol mo rgya cher bya: rjes su dam tshig bsgo ba ni: de ring phyin chad bu khyod kyis: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la: bla ma gtsug gi rgyan du zungs: lha bsgom sngags bzlas rgyun ma bcad: rang gzhan don kun rtag tu sgrubs: bus kyang khas blang gtang rag 'bul: dbang 'di lan gcig thob pas kyang: padma gtum pos byin brlabs nas: bar chad kun gyis nye mi nus: mthar thug dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub: sa ma ya rgya: byang chub sgrub la bar gcod pa'i: srog bdag gza' klu rgyal 'gong btsan: bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa thams cad kyi: gnyen po gcig tu dril ba'i lha: padma gtum po'i sgrub thabs 'di: o rgyan bla ma'i thugs khrag ste: ma 'ongs bod khams sdug bsngal dus: las 'phro can gyi dpal du shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: zab rgya: gnyan rgya: gsang rgya: kha thaṃ: gu hya: mi 'gyur las 'phro gling pa'i gter ma'o// dpe gter gzhung dngos dang*/ smin grol dag snang nye brgyud de/ las 'phro gling pa'i ye shes kyi sku las padma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling pas gsan/ des bdag rjes su bzung ba'o// //
